metadata.description: Four small Claude Code mods: hide secrets from tool results, see how far your plan is, get warned when a task is marked done with untested code, and see what fills the context window and when the prompt cache expires.

plugins.name: secret-guard
plugins.description: Hides secrets in tool results before Claude reads them: the secret values of every .env and .env.* from your session's folder up to the drive root, and anything that looks like a secret; tells Claude how to use them without printing them

plugins.name: plan-meter
plugins.description: A band above the prompt with how far your plan file is (phases and steps done, what is in progress, what is next) and Claude's own task list

plugins.name: done-gate
plugins.description: Warns Claude and you when a task is marked done while code it changed has not been tested since; a band shows the last test run. It never blocks

plugins.name: context-meter
plugins.description: A band above the prompt with what fills the context window, by category, a countdown to when the prompt cache expires, and a Compact button
